description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor class in the OpenMRS project. It verifies that the interceptor appropriately zeroes out milliseconds in Date objects when saving or updating Person entities, ensuring consistency across database operations.

classes.name: DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of DropMillisecondsHibernateInterceptor related to zeroing out milliseconds in date fields during save and update operations.

methods.name: shouldClearMillisecondsWhenSavingANewObject
methods.description: Tests that a newly created Person's birthdate has its milliseconds cleared upon saving.

methods.name: shouldClearMillisecondsWhenUpdatingAnExistingObject
methods.description: Tests that updating an existing Person's birthdate clears milliseconds.

methods.name: shouldNotChangeWhenInstanceOfTime
methods.description: Ensures that the interceptor does not alter Time instances.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowUnsupportedOperationExceptionWhenInstanceOfSqlDate
methods.description: Verifies that the interceptor handles java.sql.Date objects without throwing exceptions.
